The Claude app on April 23, 2026. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, is reportedly moving forward with its initial public offering plans.

SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic filed papers Monday to sell shares to the public for the first time.

The filing sets up the San Francisco company for a Wall Street debut next month in what could be the biggest ever initial public sale of stock.
